UPDATE nonce.nonce_assignments
                    SET state = $2
                    WHERE (execution_id, revision) = (
                        SELECT execution_id, revision
                        FROM nonce.nonce_assignments
                        WHERE execution_id = $1
                            AND state = 'reserved'
                        ORDER BY revision DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
                    )
